reported_integration_issue.current_status: Resolved by inspected code and deterministic interleaving regression
reported_integration_issue.finding: Workflow control commits its state before a second job-cleanup transaction. Stale pause cleanup can cancel a newer concurrent resume's queued job
reported_integration_issue.recommended_repair: Recheck exact controlled workflow version/status before any job cleanup, or atomically commit workflow control and job mutation
reported_integration_issue.implemented_repair: The cleanup transaction acquires the tenant lock, rereads the workflow and compares exact version/status before cancelling any jobs. A stale cleanup returns the newer workflow without mutating its jobs
reported_integration_issue.regression: tests/test_revision_integration.py::test_late_pause_cleanup_does_not_cancel_a_newer_resume injects a completed resume and new-version job between the first control commit and cleanup; it asserts the new job survives and continues to Needs Review
